newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stronger on bullish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stronger on bullish sentiment.

text.p: Indonesia's rupiah strengthened against the dollar on sustained bullish sentiment in active late trading on Thursday, dealers said.
They said selling of dollars by offshore and local players seemed to have pushed the rupiah up to Wednesday's high of around 2,326.0 level after the band widening.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,325.75/26.25 at 0900 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,327.5/29.0.
"Overall sentiment remains bullish on the rupiah. But I'm a little bit confused over the present market trend," one Japanese bank dealer said.
He said operators were seen unloading six-month swap while buying three-month swap, giving a mixed picture over the short term direction and made it difficult to forecast the trend.
The dealer said the issue was also blurred by some uptrend of overnight dollar deposit rates to 5.625/5.75 percent.
"It's a bit difficult to draw a clear picture. I just go based on technical factors, whether the currency is oversold or overbought. I just try to be a little bit faster," he said.
Some dealers said operators were seen selling outright from the morning as the swap market was neglected during the hectic spot trading on Wednesday.
One U.S. bank dealer said Singapore operators were seen taking profit from the swap market.
The dealer said spot rupiah was well resisted at the 2,329.0 level before it was broken to reach new strength.
He said operators were getting more cautious because the rate now was much more determined by market forces than by looking to the central bank for direction.
The central bank on Wednesday widened its intervention band to eight percent from five percent.
It also raised the minimum reserve requirement ratio to five percent from three percent effective April 16, 1997.
Overnight swap was at 0.35/0.45 and tom/next at 1.0/1.1.
One-month swap was quoted 14.75/15.75, two at 32.25/33.50, three at 47.50/48.25 and six at 97.00/98.25 points.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention rate at 2,309/2,501 and the conversion rate at 2,309/2,357 on Thursday.
